name: Proposal Acceptance Awaiting Internal Review
description: Public acceptance and administrative status changes record the commercial decision without provisioning clients or projects. Only explicit internal approval binds the reviewed client/project and retains the selected private document package. Synchronization and retries use the same confirmed association while preserving existing resources. Backend invariants are covered by API/service tests; the browser journey is registered as admin-proposal-approval. The legacy flow id is retained for registry compatibility.
